Messages.Author: Dave Green
Messages.Body:
David Naseby <d.na...@unsw.edu.au> wrote:
: Is it possible to deflect at any time during a bleed? for example, if I

: was being bled, attempted to block with a minion, predator stealths
: past, I say I cannot block, he dumps a conditioning on top, can the
: minion who attempted to block still play deflection at this point?

That would be the danger of conditioning. It's even better if
you can lure the bleeder up to 3 or 4 stealth before deflecting
it (playing the appropriate intercept to do so, of course).
This works for any reaction card, though I believe that playing
a reaction card gives the actor an additional opportunity to
play action modifiers, as appropriate.

-Dave Green
